zone: B01e Rm 1530 (Breezeway Office) - 14A006FEC Testing Station, FC-A
action: WO #400161 continued - root cause found: Remote Setpoint Mode was set to 'Network With Hardware Backup', so a stale network setpoint (69.5F) permanently overrode the physical wall thermostat - dial adjustments had zero effect regardless of setting. Separately, CLG-MAXFLOW was capped equal to CLG-MINFLOW (50=50cfm), leaving zero cooling modulation range (CLG-O read Unreliable with no calculable range).
outcome: Two fixes applied on 14A006FEC (FC-A): (1) Remote Setpoint Mode changed to Hardware Only (Present Value + Relinquish Default) - confirmed thermostat now drives EFFCLG-SP/EFFHTG-SP live, verified by dialing to 69F and 80F and watching both effective setpoints track in real time. (2) CLG-MAXFLOW raised 50->100cfm - CLG-O cleared from Unreliable to a real % and airflow began modulating. CLGOCC-SP/HTGOCC-SP set to 68-72F range per lab policy. Confirmed heat only calls when zone temp is below the now-tracking setpoint. Note: Reheat/Radiant valve feedback stays flat regardless of commanded output - known unwired-feedback quirk on these units, not a new fault.
